desc: Parse \(N\) and the binary string \(A\), including whitespace-separated input.
Implement bottom-up two-state dynamic programming over ternary tree levels.
Combine each triple of child states using majority transitions.
Determine the unchanged root value and output the minimum cost for forcing the opposite value.
Ensure \(O(3^N)\) time, safe memory usage, and correct handling of \(N \le 13\).
